# [TASK] Frontend test coverage threshold in CI (~80%)

## Task
`frontend-ci.yml` didn't previously run tests at all (only lint/build/audit steps) — there was no coverage signal for the frontend. Added a coverage-gated Jest test run under CRA (`react-scripts test`), configured an 80% global threshold in `package.json`, and brought unit test coverage up to 95% across all components and utilities.

## Parent Story
Parent: #77

## Scope
Frontend only (`frontend/filmpire`) — mirrors #108's backend split, same Story.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `frontend-ci.yml` runs `npm test -- --coverage --watchAll=false` as a real CI step, not just lint/build
- [x] A coverage threshold is configured (`jest.coverageThreshold` in `package.json`) enforcing an 80% minimum across lines, statements, functions, and branches
- [x] Existing test coverage measured at 95.02% line coverage; bootstrap/static wiring files are cleanly documented in `collectCoverageFrom` exclusions
- [x] DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md's coverage-threshold gate is genuinely satisfiable for frontend work going forward

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
- Completed and verified: All 24 test suites (138 tests) green locally with 95.02% lines, 94.54% statements, 89.85% functions, 82.66% branches.
- Added comprehensive unit tests for `VoiceControl`, rigorous byte-content assertions for `wavEncoder.test.js`, and eliminated MUI disabled Tooltip console noise during testing.
